issues.message: 388 blocks, over the common budget of 350 (docs/STRUCTURES.md). A warning only.

notes.detail: Interior is well furnished (six beds with footlockers, hearth, arms store), but the outside has only two torches, plain glass panes and the hay dummy: no sills, shutters, boxes or lanterns.
notes.depth: Dark oak posts, cobble plinth and the eave overhang work on the long sides; both gables and the back wall are flat.
notes.roof: Steep with overhang and dark oak eaves, but the slopes and both gable triangles are one flat spruce colour with no gable trim or ridge accent.
notes.shape: A long box; the brick chimney is the only break.
notes.life: Only moss on the plinth and torches; no plants, path is a single step.

visual.summary: Long stone-and-timber bunkhouse with six beds along a centre aisle, a hearth and arms store; reads as a barracks inside, but the outside is plain.
problems: Back wall (z=12, x=2..5, y=2..3) is solid white terracotta with no window or post: add a window or a middle timber post.
Both gables (z=2 and z=12, y=5..7) are plain spruce planks: add a dark oak tie beam / king post or a contrasting trim along the verges.
Front and side windows have no sills or shutters: add trapdoor shutters or a slab sill under the glass panes (y=2 on x=1/x=7 and front z=2).
No plants at the base: a few flowers or leaf bushes along the plinth would lift it (L1 shell can stay modest, but needs something).
Reach: all rooms and the aisle are reached; only roof slopes and the hay dummy top are unreached (fine).

notes.detail: Round-1 problems all fixed: back window with posts, half-timbered gables (plaster in dark oak), trapdoor shutters and sills, leaf bushes and poppies, upside-down stairs and beam ends under the gable overhang.
notes.purpose: From outside it reads as a stone and timber house; only the hay dummy by the door says 'military'. The beds and arms store are inside where nobody sees them.
notes.shape: A box with a chimney; no porch or lean-to at L1 (fine for a shell).
notes.scale: Carlton's 'bloated' note is answered: 7 x 8 instead of 7 x 11, four beds, no empty filler room; 344 blocks.

visual.summary: Slimmed stone and timber barracks shell (7 x 8, four beds, hearth under a brick chimney) with half-timbered gables, shutters, sills and a hay dummy at the door; clearly slimmer and more detailed than v1.
problems: Reads as a cottage more than a barracks from outside: a small weapon rack or shield on the front wall beside the door (z=1, x=2 or x=6, y=2) would say 'soldiers' at L1.
Reach: the whole interior and centre aisle are reached; only roof slopes, the chimney top, the dummy top and two trapdoor sills are unreached (fine).
